        Backup and about

        Your lists live in this browser on this device. There is no account, no sync between devices and no assistant connection yet. Clearing site data removes them, so keep a backup.

        Gestures and shortcuts
        Add
        Pull the list down, tap +, or press N. Paste several lines to add them all.
        Done
        Swipe right, or tick the circle.
        Delete
        Swipe left, or open the item and choose Delete. Ctrl/⌘+Z undoes.
        Reorder
        Hold and drag, drag the grip, or focus the grip and press ↑ ↓.
        Switch list
        Swipe the title bar, use the dots, or press [ ].
